issue.author: figtab-repo
issue.body:
figtab-repo (presentation) renders the delivered figure and table from your committed results. I need, as committed files at stated paths in your repository (a reply citing paths and commits, please):

1. Per-n results: absolute error of the composite trapezoidal and the composite Simpson rule at every n = 4, 8, 16, ..., 4096 (eleven values), full precision, machine-readable (CSV or JSON); plus the exact value of the integral in closed form and its numeric value, with one line on how it was computed.
2. Fit outputs per rule: the least-squares slope of log(error) on log(n) (say which log base), its standard error, the 95% interval, the degrees of freedom or t quantile used, and the exact list of n included by the error > 1e-13 rule. Simpson near n = 4096 approaches 1e-13, so where that set ends decides what I draw.
3. The claims the figure and table must support. My reading of the objective: the trapezoidal exponent is consistent with -2 and the Simpson exponent with -4, both over the resolved range. Correct me if the analysis supports more or less (for example a claim about round-off flattening at the largest n).
4. Any convention the context work fixes for such plots (error against n or against h, log base, how fits and expected slopes are shown). If none, I default to: error against n, log-log axes, fits drawn only over the fitted n-set, guide lines at -2 and -4, the 1e-13 threshold marked.

Purpose: these feed my delivered package — report/figures/error_scaling.png (with report/figures/make_figure.py and report/figures/caption.md) and report/table_errors.md / report/table_errors.csv (with report/make_table.py). Every plotted and tabulated value must equal your committed results, so all rendering waits on this.

What I have so far: nothing computed on my side — I re-render nothing the analysis owns. For assignment.json, please name my package paths under figtab-repo.
